name: @cortexkit/pi-openai-auth
description: Pi package for CortexKit OpenAI Codex OAuth support. It overrides Pi's built-in `openai-codex` provider with a CortexKit provider extension backed by Pi's OpenAI Codex Responses transport and OAuth primitives.
